Removing 
the Screw Spindle Assembly from 
the Drive end
Withdraw pump half coupling by means of extractor gear.
Remove coupling key from the driving shaft.

قم بتحرير برغي الغطاء وقم بإزالة الخرطوشة باتجاه نهاية محرك الأقراص. (استخدم الاصطياد 
 مسامير).

Remove bearing cover by means of jacking screws. Ball bearing and stationary 
 seal ring remain the bearing cover.

After removal of the complete bearing cover .the stationary seal ring can be 
 easily dismounted.

The ball bearing and the grease guide ring of design EG are removed from the 
 bearing cover inside by means of a doily.

Now the mechanical seal parts fitted on the drive spindle are stripped off 
 with particular care release cap screw . Remove drive end pump cover from 
 casing insert.
Release cap screw, remove drive and pump cover from casing insert.

Dismount complete screw spindle assembly consisting of drive spindle with 
 shrunk on shaft collar the two idler spindles and the balancing bushes fitted 
 thereon by pulling it out of the casing insert towards the drive end. Remove 
 idler spindles and balancing bushes from the drive spindle.

sections.text:
Before assembling the pump. Care must be taken that all components are free 
 from dirt and abrasive particles. To re-assemble the pump, proceed in reverse 
 order than described for the disassembly.

During assembly and installation of the screw spindle assembly care must be 
 taken that the color coding of the three spindles are in one direction. The 
 color coded drive spindle tooth must engage in the color coded tooth gaps of 
 the idler spindling before the installation. The screw spindle assembly must 
 be well oiled with acid-free oil.

When mounting the mechanical seal. Special care must be taken that for 
 cleaning the components only clean rags and no cotton wool is used and that 
 seal faces are not damaged. The seal rings must never be placed on the seal 
 faces, the seal faces must be clean and should poor to assembly, be slightly 
 oiled with clean oil. Prior to fitting on the drive spindle. Slightly oil 
 shaft and attend to proper sequence of components

Assemble the remaining parts of the pump in the reverse order of the 
 disassembly.
